title: (option to) Don't store location history
body:
**Use case**
Recent release adds 24 hour rolling location history. This is a privacy problem, and not required, though it may be useful 


**Proposed Solution**
Add option to disable trail. 
Add first run question (default to more private) 

You might want to think about this from a GDPR data minimisation point of view...
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
comments.body:
> You might want to think about this from a GDPR data minimisation point of view...

It is not relevant at all.

GDPR is not applying in this case as data (in raw or any processed form) is never send by StreetComplete anywhere. It stays on your device.

scope: Current retrievable issue body and issue comments; not the original study's historical snapshot. Linked pages and attachments are not fetched.
